high.title: USD Nearly Reaches IDR 18,000, Purbaya Says Many Negative Issues in Market
high.summary: Finance Minister Purbaya addresses the sharp weakening of rupiah against USD, attributing it to market rumors and negative sentiment. The currency has approached the critical IDR 18,000 level, causing significant concern for Indonesian markets.

high.title: IHSG Suddenly Plunges 4-5% to 5,946 Level
high.summary: Indonesian stock index IHSG experienced a dramatic sell-off, falling over 4% from 6,200 levels to below 6,000. This represents a significant market correction driven by rupiah weakness and economic concerns.

high.title: Behind IHSG's Sudden Collapse to Nearly 5%
high.summary: Market analysts explain the root causes of IHSG's sharp decline, primarily driven by rupiah weakening against USD and deteriorating Indonesian economic indicators. The currency fell 0.55% to IDR 17,936.5 per dollar.

high.title: Purbaya Speaks on USD Breaking IDR 18,000: I Leave It to BI
high.summary: Finance Minister confirms USD has breached the IDR 18,000 psychological barrier, reaching IDR 18,044. He delegates currency stability management to Bank Indonesia, indicating confidence in BI's ability to handle the crisis.

high.title: The Culprit Behind IHSG's Sudden Collapse to 5,900 Level
high.summary: IHSG closed down 4.11% at 5,941.06 with intraday lows reaching 5,841.99, a decline of over 5%. The massive sell-off was triggered by continued rupiah weakness and slowing Indonesian economic indicators.

high.title: Rupiah and IHSG Weaken, Palace Says Economic Fundamentals Remain Strong
high.summary: Government maintains confidence in Indonesia's economic fundamentals despite IHSG falling 32.46% year-to-date and rupiah hitting IDR 18,049. Officials cite controlled inflation and economic growth as supporting factors.

medium.title: Following Orient Express Model, KAI Launches Luxury Train Nusantara Explorer July 1
medium.summary: State railway company KAI introduces premium tourism service Nusantara Explorer, inspired by Europe's Orient Express. The luxury train will serve Jakarta-Yogyakarta-Semarang-Banyuwangi route targeting niche tourism market.

medium.title: KAI-INKA Merger to Complete This Year
medium.summary: Merger between railway operator KAI and train manufacturer INKA will be finalized in 2026 under Danantara's directive. KAI will become the holding company with INKA as subsidiary, part of government's SOE rationalization program.

medium.title: Kimia Farma Turns Loss into Profit of IDR 123.63 Billion
medium.summary: State pharmaceutical company Kimia Farma achieved remarkable turnaround in Q1 2026, posting IDR 123.63 billion profit versus IDR 443.35 billion loss in 2025. Revenue reached IDR 2.03 trillion with improved cost management.

medium.title: New BGN Head Announces 4 Initiatives for Free Nutritious Meal Budget Efficiency
medium.summary: New National Nutrition Agency head implements budget cuts from IDR 335 trillion to IDR 268 trillion for Free Nutritious Meal program while maintaining beneficiary targets. Focus on efficiency through better targeting and management.

medium.title: Deputy Immigration Minister Silmy Karim Becomes KPK Suspect, Owns IDR 234 Million in Assets
medium.summary: Deputy Minister of Immigration Silmy Karim surrenders to anti-corruption commission KPK following sting operation. His wealth declaration shows IDR 234.59 billion in assets, mostly Jakarta real estate holdings.

medium.title: Rupiah Collapse Threatens Thousands of Workers with Layoffs, Manufacturing Sector Most Affected
medium.summary: CORE Indonesia projects 15,300-20,300 additional job losses due to rising import costs from rupiah weakness and global supply chain disruptions. Manufacturing sector faces highest risk with 8,700-12,100 potential layoffs.

medium.title: Unilever Distributes IDR 4.32 Trillion Dividend at End of June
medium.summary: Unilever Indonesia announces final dividend of IDR 4.32 trillion for 2025, bringing total dividend to IDR 7.63 trillion. The decision follows strong 2025 performance with IDR 31.9 trillion in sales and IDR 3.5 trillion net profit.

medium.title: Multiple Aspects Show Growth, Alfamart Distributes IDR 1.7 Trillion Dividend
medium.summary: Retail chain Alfamart approves IDR 1.7 trillion dividend distribution (IDR 41.5 per share) following strong 2025 performance. The decision reflects the company's solid financial performance across multiple business aspects.
